blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Reliable evaluation of inter-annotator agreement (IAA) is important for assessing the consistency of annotation processes. While established IAA metrics such as Cohen's kappa, Fleiss' kappa, and Krippendorff's alpha are commonly applied in single-label settings, multi-label tasks require additional decisions about how full label sets, joint selections, and joint omissions should be compared.
  In this work, we present Multi-Label Agreement (MLA), a flexible framework for evaluating agreement in multi-label annotation tasks. MLA preserves the full binary label vectors assigned to each item and uses average pairwise Hamming agreement, thereby accounting for both joint selections and joint omissions. Its pooled-marginal form is not a mathematically independent coefficient: it is a chance-disagreement-weighted average of label-wise Fleiss/Scott-type coefficients and is closely related to Krippendorff's alpha with normalized Hamming distance. The framework supports pooled-marginal, Gwet AC1, and fixed-baseline normalizations, yields item-level, label-level, and corpus-level results, and includes a conditional minimum-agreement diagnostic. Through a worked example and Monte Carlo simulations, we show how the resulting values depend on label prevalence, the declared label inventory, and the selected model of expected agreement. We also provide a Python implementation. MLA thus offers a transparent and interpretable framework for multi-label agreement analysis without claiming that one normalization is universally preferable.
blocks.zh:
对通知人之间的协议进行可靠的评价对评估通知程序的一致性十分重要。 虽然建立IAA的度量衡如Cohen's kappa,Fleiss' kappa,和Krippendorff的α在单标签设置中通常被应用,但多标签任务需要额外决定如何比较完整标签集,联合选择,以及联合遗漏.
在这项工作中,我们提出“多标签协定”,这是在多标签注释任务中评估协议的灵活框架。 MLA保留了分配给每个项的全二进制标签向量,并使用平均对等的汉明协议,从而既计入了联合选择,又计入了联合遗漏. 它的集合-边际形式不是一个数学上独立的系数:它是一种概率-偏差-加权平均的标签-顺理成章的Fleiss/Scott-type系数,并和克里彭多夫的α与正统的哈明距离密切相关. 该框架支持集合-边际、Gwet AC1和固定基线正常化、生产项目级、标签级和实体级结果,并包括有条件的最低协议诊断。 通过一个实例和蒙特卡洛模拟,我们展示了由此产生的数值如何取决于标签的普及程度、申报的标签清单以及预期协议的选定模式。 我们还提供Python的执行。 因此,司法协助为多标签协议分析提供了一个透明和可解释的框架,而不声称一种正常化是普遍可取的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: To assess the reproducibility of an annotation process, annotation studies commonly report inter-annotator agreement , also known as inter-coder or inter-rater agreement Carletta (1996) ; Artstein and Poesio (2008) ; Leidner (2022) . Agreement does not by itself prove that the annotations are valid or that they form an upper bound for a downstream classifier, but it can reveal unclear guidelines, inconsistent use of categories, and systematic differences between annotators.
blocks.zh: 为了评估注解过程的再发性,注解研究通常报告注解者之间的协议,也称为编码者间协议或辩证者间协议Carletta(1996年);Artstein和Poesio(2008年);Leidner(2022年)。 协议本身并不能证明说明是有效的,或构成下游分类者的上层约束,但它可以揭示出准则不明确,类别使用不一致,以及注释者之间的系统差异.

blocks.en: This is done by having a set of human subjects annotate a shared set of data items so their individual decisions can be compared. After all annotators annotate the same piece of data and inter-annotator agreement (IAA) is established, annotators may each work on their own data subset without overlap to save time and money.
blocks.zh: 这是通过让一组人类主体对一组共享的数据项目进行注释,从而可以比较它们各自的决定。 在所有注释员对同一块数据和注释员间协议(IAA)进行注释后,注释员可以各自工作在自己的数据子集上而不重叠,以节省时间和金钱.

blocks.en: Factors that hurt IAA include unspecified, ambiguous, or differently interpreted annotation guidelines as well as human performance effects like lapses of concentration. A good annotation guideline codebook describes each class clearly and provides examples and counterexamples to differentiate it from other classes. Typically, writing the codebook requires several iterations, with multiple updates following each round of pre-trial annotations Artstein (2017) ; Leidner (2022) . At the same time, disagreement is not always annotation noise. In subjective tasks it may reflect genuine differences in interpretation and can itself be useful information Plank et al. (2014) ; Uma et al. (2021) .
blocks.zh: 伤害《国际仲裁裁决汇编》的因素包括未具体说明、模棱两可或有不同解释的注释准则,以及人类业绩的影响,如集中失效。 一个很好的注解准则代码手册清楚地描述了每一类,并提供了实例和反例,以区别于其他类. 通常情况下,写代码本需要多个迭代,每轮预审说明Artstein(2017年);Leidner(2022年)之后有多个更新. 同时,分歧并不总是说明性的噪音。 在主观任务中,它可能反映解释上的真正差异,本身可以是有用的信息Plank等人(2014年);Uma等人(2021年)。

blocks.en: Tasks may be inherently ambiguous given a particular set of categories, or different annotators may display divergent annotation behavior even when using the same codebook, due, for example, to concentration issues.
blocks.zh: 任务在本质上可能是模糊的,因为有一组特定的类别,或者不同的注释者可能表现出不同的注释行为,即使使用同一个代码簿,例如由于集中问题。

blocks.en: Depending on the annotation setup, several established metrics can be used to assess IAA. With two annotators and one categorical label for each item, Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) uses annotator-specific marginal distributions. Scott’s π \pi and Fleiss’ κ \kappa instead use pooled marginals, with Fleiss’ formulation accommodating more than two annotations per item ( Fleiss, 1971 ; Di Eugenio and Glass, 2004 ; Artstein and Poesio, 2008 ) . Krippendorff’s α \alpha ( Krippendorff, 2011 ; Krippendorff, 2013 ) supports any number of annotators, missing data, and user-defined distance functions. This last feature also permits set-valued or vector-valued annotations.
blocks.zh: 根据注释设置,可以使用若干既定的度量衡来评估IAA. Cohen's $\kappa(Cohen, 1960年)使用注释器特有的边际分布。 Scott 的 \pi 和 Fleiss 的 \ kappa 使用集合边框, Fleiss 的配方包含两个以上的说明(Fleiss, 1971年; Di Eugenio and Glass, 2004年;Artstein and Poesio, 2008年)。 Krippendorff 的 α\ alpha (Krippendorff, 2011; Krippendorff, 2013) 支持任意数量的注释器,缺失的数据,以及用户定义的距离函数. 最后一个功能还允许设定值或矢量值说明.

blocks.en: For a formal description of a multi-label annotation task, let N N be the number of data items i i to be annotated by n n annotators, each of whom assigns a total of k k category labels (assigning in this case also includes not assigning, as the absence of a label is also information). For each item and annotator, we therefore do not have a single decision but a set of decisions L L with L ∈ { 0 , 1 } k L\in\{0,1\}^{k} .

Thus, for each item and annotator, you end up with ℓ i , c ∈ { 1 , 2 , … , k } \ell_{i,c}\in\{1,2,\dots,k\} , where ℓ i , c \ell_{i,c} denotes the single category label selected by annotator (coder) c c for item i i .

blocks.en: There are at least two natural ways to proceed. One can treat every label as a separate binary annotation problem and combine the resulting statistics, or treat the entire label set as one structured value and select a distance between two sets. These approaches are not necessarily different: normalized Hamming distance is additive over labels, and therefore reduces the vector comparison to a particular weighting of label-wise comparisons.
blocks.zh: 至少有两种自然的方法可以进行。 人们可以将每个标签作为一个单独的二进制注释问题来对待,并结合由此产生的统计数据,或者将整个标签集作为一个结构值来对待,并在两套之间选择一个距离. 这些方法不一定不同:正常的Hamming距离比标签更具有添加性,因此将矢量比作特定的标签加权比较.

blocks.en: This paper makes that relationship explicit. We call the resulting framework Multi-Label Agreement (MLA), retaining the terminology used in the accompanying software. MLA is not a mathematically independent coefficient family; instead, our contributions are (i) an exact decomposition into label-wise coefficients, (ii) the connection to Krippendorff’s α \alpha with Hamming distance, (iii) a conditional lower bound showing how far agreement can fall for the observed prevalences, and (iv) a practical comparison of alternative chance terms and set similarities.
blocks.zh: 本文明确了这种关系。 我们称之为由此产生的框架多标签协议,保留附带软件中使用的术语。 MLA不是一个数学上独立的系数家族;相反,我们的贡献是(一) 精确地分解成标注系数,(二) 与Krippendorff的α\α与Hamming距离的关联,(三) 有条件的下限,显示对观测到的流行程度的一致程度,以及(四) 对替代机会术语和设定相似性的实际比较。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Past Work on Multi-Label IAA
blocks.zh: 2.1 以往关于多标签IAA的工作

blocks.en: Multi-label agreement has been approached both through dedicated coefficients and through general weighted agreement frameworks. The latter perspective is particularly important because Krippendorff’s α \alpha can treat a label set as a structured value and use a distance such as Hamming, Jaccard, or MASI ( Artstein and Poesio, 2008 ; Passonneau, 2006 ) . Recent annotation systems consequently use α \alpha with MASI distance for multi-label monitoring ( Jukić et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 已经通过专用系数和一般加权协议框架处理多标签协议。 后一种观点尤为重要,因为Krippendorff的α\α可以将一个标签集视为结构化的值,并使用像Hamming,Jaccard,或者MASI(Artstein and Poesio,2008;Passonneau,2006)这样的距离. 因此,最近的注释系统使用α-α与MASI距离进行多标签监测(Jukić等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Rosenberg and Binkowski (2004) proposed an augmentation of Cohen’s kappa, treating multiple labels not as a legitimate outcome of a task but rather a problem arising from annotator uncertainty, following the assumption that there has to be one true label and annotators just struggle to agree which one it is. The way it is calculated essentially boils down to the kappa for a scenario where coders were only allowed to give one label and had randomly selected one of multiple provided labels. Thus, this metric has been designed to deflate with the number of labels used, a higher number of labels automatically leads to a lower score. This is not really suitable for an annotation task where an item could have several true labels.
blocks.zh: Rosenberg和Binkowski (2004年)建议增加Cohen的kapa, 将多重标签不视为一项任务的合法结果,而是由注释者不确定性引起的问题, 假设必须有一个真正的标签, 注释者只是挣扎着同意它是什么。 其计算方式基本上可归结为kappa, 用于一种只允许编码者给出一个标签且曾随机选择多个提供的标签之一的情景. 因此,这个度量衡的设计是为了与使用的标签数量一起降级,较高数量的标签自动导致分数较低. 这并不适合一个项目可能有多个真实标签的注释任务.

blocks.en: Marchal et al. (2022) propose a computational approach that uses bootstrapping to estimate chance agreement in multi-label data, while assessing agreement only over the intersection of annotators’ label sets and deliberately ignoring labels that were never assigned to an item. While this is a defensible design choice, the simulated (rather than analytic) chance term can be more difficult to interpret, and discarding the information conveyed by joint non-selections means that agreement on a label’s absence is treated as if the label had never been available for that item in the first place.
blocks.zh: Marchal等人(2022年)提出了一种计算方法,用靴子钓法来估计多标签数据中的机会协议,同时只评估注释者标签集的交叉点上的协议,并故意忽略从未分配给某个项目的标签. 虽然这是一个合理的设计选择,但模拟的(而不是分析的)机会术语可能更难解释,而放弃联合非选择所传递的信息意味着,关于某一标签的缺席的协议被视为最初从未为该标签提供过。

blocks.en: MASI was introduced by Passonneau (2006) and combines the Jaccard index with a penalty factor based on the degree of overlap, ranging from no penalty for an exact match, to a small penalty for a subset match, to a higher penalty for non-subset overlap between label sets. MASI itself is a distance or similarity, not a chance-corrected coefficient; it can be reported directly or supplied as the distance function in a coefficient such as α \alpha .
blocks.zh: MASI是由Passonneau(2006)引入的,将Jaccard指数与基于重合程度的罚因子结合,从对精确匹配的不罚,对子集匹配的不罚,到标签集之间非子集重叠的较罚. MASI本身是一个距离或相似性,而不是偶然修正的系数;它可以直接报告,也可以作为α\α等系数中的距离函数提供.

blocks.en: Bhowmick et al. (2008) introduce the Am coefficient, a κ \kappa -style statistic that extends pairwise agreement to the multi-label setting by treating every unordered pair of categories as a separate nominal variable. For each item, annotators’ three possible decisions for a category pair, (0,0), (1,1), or (0,1)/(1,0), are compared; the observed overlap is then normalized with a chance term derived from the product of the individual annotators’ marginal probabilities. Because it averages over all pairs, it implicitly weights errors between frequently co-occurring labels more heavily, yields only a single corpus-wide score, and inherits κ \kappa ’s sensitivity to skewed prevalence while further scaling quadratically in the number of labels.
blocks.zh: Bhowmick 等人(2008年)引入了 Am 系数,这是 $\kappa 式的比对,通过将每个无序的对类作为一个单独的名义变量来将配对协议延伸至多标签设置. 对每件物品,对一对类别(0,0, 1, 或(0, 1)/(1, 0))的三种可能的决定进行了比较;然后将观察到的重叠与个别的注释者边际概率的产物产生的机会术语正常化。 由于它平均覆盖所有对子,它隐含地权衡了经常共同出现的标签之间的差错,只得出一个单一整体的得分,并继承了\kappa对扭曲流行的敏感度,同时进一步以四倍比例放大标签的数量。

blocks.en: Related work on learning from disagreement and soft evaluation asks a different but connected question: whether the distribution of annotator judgements should be preserved rather than reduced to a single gold label ( Uma et al., 2021 ; Rizzi et al., 2024 ; Harju and Mesaros, 2023 ) . Multi-label confusion matrices and tensors likewise provide detailed classification diagnostics but do not themselves model chance agreement ( Heydarian et al., 2022 ; Krstinić et al., 2024 ) . These lines of work reinforce a central point of the present paper: a single corpus-level coefficient should be accompanied by diagnostics that preserve where and how disagreement occurs.
blocks.zh: 关于从分歧和软评价中学习的相关工作提出了一个不同但相互关联的问题:是否应保留注释员判决的分配,而不是缩小为单一的金牌(Uma等人,2021年;Rizzi等人,2024年;Harju和Mesaros,2023年)。 多标签混淆矩阵和分解器同样提供了详细的分类诊断,但本身并不是机会协议范本(Heydarian等人,2022年;Krstinić等人,2024年)。 这些工作领域强化了本文件的一个中心要点:一个单一的单位级系数应伴有诊断,以保留分歧发生地点和方式。

blocks.en: 2.2 The Ongoing Chance Correction Debate
blocks.zh: 2.2 持续的机会矫正辩论

blocks.en: Many agreement coefficients have the form ( A o − A e ) / ( 1 − A e ) (A_{o}-A_{e})/(1-A_{e}) , where A o A_{o} is observed agreement and A e A_{e} is a model-dependent baseline. The word “chance” can obscure that A e A_{e} is not observed independently of the data: it follows from a particular model of how annotations would be allocated in the absence of the agreement of interest ( Di Eugenio and Glass, 2004 ; Artstein and Poesio, 2008 ) .

blocks.en: For a binary label j j , let p j p_{j} denote the pooled proportion of positive decisions across annotators and items. The corresponding baseline p j 2 + ( 1 − p j ) 2 p_{j}^{2}+(1-p_{j})^{2} is Fleiss/Scott-type because it uses a pooled marginal. It should not be called Cohen’s κ \kappa , whose two-annotator model keeps the annotators’ marginal distributions separate.
blocks.zh: 对于二进制标签j j , 让 p j p_{j } 表示所有注释者和项目的正决定的集合比例 。 对应的基线p j 2 + (1–p j) 2 p j }^{2}+(1-p_{j}) ^{2}是弗莱斯/斯科特型,因为它使用集合边际. 它不应该被称为Cohen的 $\kappa , 他的双注释模型使注释者的边际分布是分开的。

blocks.en: Kappa-like coefficients can become small in situations with high raw agreement and skewed prevalence. Gwet’s AC1 ( Gwet, 2001 ) uses a different baseline and often remains higher in such situations. PABAK ( Byrt et al., 1993 ) , also known in this binary form as the Brennan–Prediger coefficient, fixes the baseline at 0.5 0.5 .
blocks.zh: 类似Kappa的系数在原始协议高和流行率偏差的情况下会变得很小。 Gwet的AC1(Gwet,2001年)使用不同的基线,在这种情况下往往更高。 PABAK(Byrt等人,1993年),也以这一二进制形式称为Brennan-Prediger系数,将基线定为0.5 0.5。

blocks.en: Konstantinidis et al. ( Konstantinidis et al., 2022 ) provide simulation evidence that Gwet’s AC1 often attains lower sampling variance than several kappa estimators in multiple-rater, binary-outcome settings and therefore recommend AC1 when skewed prevalences and small sample sizes make kappa unstable.
blocks.zh: 康斯坦丁尼蒂斯等人著. (Konstantinidis等人,2022年)提供了模拟证据,证明Gwet的AC1在多端、二进制结果环境中往往比几个Kappa估计器获得较低的采样差异,因此当流行率偏差和样本小使Kappa不稳定时,建议使用AC1。

blocks.en:
Zec et al. ( Zec et al., 2017 ) highlight the classic "kappa paradox", cases of high raw agreement but extreme category prevalence where Cohen’s κ \kappa can appear deceptively low, and show empirical examples in which AC1 (and related measures) avoid that particular interpretive pitfall.
Conversely, Vach and Gerke ( Vach and Gerke, 2023 ) stress that AC1 is not a drop-in replacement: substituting AC1 for κ \kappa changes the underlying model rather than repairing the same estimand. We therefore treat these normalizations as sensitivity analyses. Their values answer different questions and should not be selected after looking at which one gives the most favourable result.
blocks.zh:
Zec等人著. (Zec et al., 2017)凸显了经典的"kappa悖论",即高原协议但极端类流行的情况,其中Cohen's oble \kappa可以显得欺骗性低,并展示了AC1(和相关措施)避免该特定解释陷阱的经验实例.
反之,Vach和Gerke(Vach和Gerke,2023年)强调AC1不是即时替换:用AC1代替o&kappa来改变基本模型,而不是修补相同的意象. 因此,我们将这些正常化视为敏感性分析。 他们的价值观回答了不同的问题,不应在考虑哪一个结果最有利之后加以选择。

blocks.en: 3.6 Interpreting Prevalence
blocks.zh: 3.6 解释流行率

blocks.en: When the raw prevalence p r p_{r} is near 0, almost every coder assigns 0 to almost every label. Because a ( 0 , 0 ) (0,0) comparison counts as agreement, A o A_{o} can become high even when coders rarely coincide on the scarce positive cases. This matters in tasks where recognizing an occasional positive label is the actual challenge. Take the rabbit–duck illusion: coders may dispute whether a rabbit, a duck, or both are present, yet they will unanimously agree that other animals are absent. Expanding the inventory with irrelevant animals therefore inflates Hamming agreement without improving reliability on the labels of interest.
blocks.zh: 当原始流行 p r p_{r} 接近 0时, 几乎每个编码器都会给几乎每个标签分配 0 。 因为a( 0, 0) ( 0) ( 0) 比较算作协议, A o A_{o} 即使编码者很少与稀缺的正数吻合, 也会变得很高。 在承认偶尔出现正面标记是实际挑战的任务中,这一点很重要。 使用兔子的假象:编码者可能会质疑兔子、鸭子或两者是否都在场, 因此,用无关的动物来扩大库存,从而夸大了哈明协议,而没有提高有关标签的可靠性。

blocks.en: A low p r p_{r} is not automatically a problem. In some applications positives are genuinely rare and certifying their absence is an important part of the task. Think of aircraft-maintenance engineers who tick possible defects on an inspection checklist: almost all boxes will, and should, remain unticked. Here, joint omissions may be meaningful. The relevant question is therefore not whether negative matches should always count, but whether all labels were genuinely considered and whether confirming their absence has comparable value to confirming their presence.

A single global prevalence is insufficient for making this judgement, so the label-wise p j p_{j} , A o , j A_{o,j} , positive agreement, and negative agreement should be inspected alongside a corpus-level coefficient.

blocks.en: Natural ambiguity also has to be separated from annotation error. Genre annotation, for example, may legitimately produce different but defensible label sets. Such disagreement should often be preserved for later analysis rather than hidden behind a reliability threshold ( Plank et al., 2014 ; Uma et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 自然模糊性也必须与注释错误区分开来. 例如,流派注释可以合法地产生不同但可防伪的标签集。 这种分歧往往应保留下来,以便日后进行分析,而不是隐藏在可靠性阈值之后(Plank等人,2014年;Uma等人,2021年)。

blocks.en: No normalization resolves this domain decision automatically. The pooled-marginal coefficient asks how much observed Hamming agreement exceeds that implied by the empirical label marginals. AC1 uses a different baseline that remains less punitive at extreme prevalence, but can consequently be positive even when annotators draw independently from the same skewed Bernoulli distribution. PABAK fixes a balanced baseline and has the same issue under skewed independent decisions. These are properties of the respective models, not evidence that one coefficient has recovered the uniquely correct amount of reliability. blocks.en: 5 Reporting Recommendations
blocks.zh: 5 报告建议

blocks.en: The analysis suggests that a multi-label reliability report should make the following choices explicit: 1. Label universe. State whether the inventory was fixed before annotation and whether every annotator was expected to consider every label. Never-selected labels should not be removed only because they lower or raise a preferred summary. 2. Meaning of joint omissions. Use Hamming-based agreement when joint absence is informative. If overlap among positive selections is the scientific focus, additionally report a set distance such as Jaccard or MASI, preferably within a chance-corrected framework when such correction is needed. 3. Baseline model. Pre-specify the primary chance model. A pooled-marginal coefficient, AC1, and PABAK do not provide three interchangeable estimates of the same quantity. 4. Diagnostics. Report N N , the number of annotators per item, k k , A o A_{o} , label-wise prevalences and agreements, and the conditional lower bound. Item-level values can identify difficult examples, but reliability conclusions require an adequate number of items. 5. Uncertainty. For substantive studies, accompany corpus-level and important label-level estimates with confidence intervals obtained through a design-appropriate bootstrap or an analytic method. Resampling must respect the item and annotator structure of the study. If labels are hierarchical, mutually exclusive in groups, or otherwise dependent, the additive Hamming construction is often not sufficient. In that case, Krippendorff’s framework with a domain-specific distance, or an explicit probabilistic annotator model, is preferable to treating the dependencies as if they did not exist.

blocks.zh: 6 执行

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The present analysis is restricted to complete, balanced annotation designs with binary, non-hierarchical labels. The simple formulas do not by themselves handle missing annotations. Treating a missing decision as 0 would incorrectly turn missingness into an observed omission; instead, pair counts and marginal denominators must be computed from the available values, as done in the general formulation of Krippendorff’s α \alpha .
blocks.zh: 本分析仅限于用二进制,非等级标签来完成平衡的注释设计. 简单的公式本身并不处理缺少的说明。 如果将缺失的决定当作0处理,就会错误地将缺失变成观察到的遗漏;相反,必须像克里彭多夫的α-α的一般表述那样,从现有数值中计算对数和边际分母。

blocks.en: Normalized Hamming distance is additive and therefore insensitive to dependencies among labels. It also weights all label decisions equally before chance correction. Hierarchical relations, mutually exclusive subsets, and differences in the cost of false positive and false negative decisions require a different distance or a model tailored to the annotation design.
blocks.zh: 正常化的汉明距离是添加剂,因此对标签中的依赖性不敏感. 它还对所有标签决定进行同等的加权,然后才进行机会纠正。 等级关系,相互排斥的子集,以及错误的正反决定的成本差异,都需要不同的距离或适合注释设计的模型.

blocks.en: The worked example contains only four items and is illustrative. The simulation varies several design factors but averages over n n , N N , and k k and does not provide inferential comparisons or confidence intervals. A more complete empirical study should analyse these factors separately, include annotator-specific marginals and correlated labels, and compare against Hamming α \alpha using the same data. Finally, tasks with genuine ambiguity may be better represented by confidence judgements or distributions over interpretations rather than binary decisions alone.
blocks.zh: 实例仅包含四个项目,是说明性的。 模拟有几种不同的设计因子,但平均值在 n , N 和 k k 以上,不提供推论比较或置信间隔. 更完整的实证研究应该分别分析这些因素,包括注释器特有的边际和相关的标签,并使用相同的数据与Hamming α\α进行比较. 最后,信心判断或对解释的分布可能更好地代表真正模糊的任务,而不只是二进制决定。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: Multi-label agreement does not require an entirely new coefficient family. Average pairwise Hamming agreement, combined with a pooled-marginal chance term, is a chance-disagreement-weighted average of label-wise Fleiss/Scott-type coefficients and is closely related to Krippendorff’s α \alpha with Hamming distance. Stating this equivalence is useful because it reveals both the strengths and the limitations of the construction: it scales linearly in the number of labels and counts joint omissions, but it decomposes over labels and does not model their dependencies.
blocks.zh: 多标签协议不需要全新的系数家族. 平均对称的汉明协议,加上集合-边际机会术语,是标注式Fleiss/Scott型系数的概率-偏差加权平均值,与Krippendorff的α-α与汉明距离密切相关. 标出这种等值是有用的,因为它既揭示了构造的优点和局限性:它按标签的数量线性地缩放并计数联合的遗漏,但它在标签上分解,不建模它们的依赖性.

blocks.en: The choice of baseline remains consequential. The pooled-marginal, AC1, and fixed 0.5 0.5 baselines can give very different values on the same annotations, especially under extreme prevalence. The simulations show that these differences follow from the models rather than from numerical instability alone. Reporting several coefficients can be a useful sensitivity analysis, but it does not remove the need to select and justify a primary estimand.
blocks.zh: 基线的选择仍然是必然的。 集合-边际、AC1和固定的0.5 0.5基线可以在同一说明上给出非常不同的数值,特别是在极端普遍的情况下。 模拟表明,这些差异来自模型,而不是数字不稳定。 报告若干系数可能是一种有用的敏感性分析,但这并不消除选择一个主要因素和说明理由的必要性。

blocks.en: The conditional minimum-agreement formula adds a complementary diagnostic. It shows how low observed and normalized agreement can feasibly fall once the number of annotators and empirical label prevalences are fixed. Together with raw agreement, label-wise results, and an explicit declaration of the label universe, this provides a more informative account than a single coefficient. The accompanying implementation packages these calculations so that the assumptions can be inspected rather than hidden behind one recommended score.
blocks.zh: 有条件的最低协议公式增加了补充性诊断. 它表明,一旦确定注释者人数和经验标签的普及程度,所观察到的和正常化的协议如何会实际下降。 加上原始协议,标签式结果,以及标签宇宙的明确声明,这提供了比单一系数更丰富的账户. 随附的执行一揽子计算,以便检查这些假设,而不是隐藏在建议得分之后。
